They are also often used by adventuring guilds to pay for various expensive amenities. | notes =
** Astral Diamonds used to be available in the [[DDO Store]] and, unlike [[Astral Shard]]s, could also drop extremely rarely in chests, as they were inventory items instead of an external currency. ** You can convert your legacy diamonds into shards at the rate of 5 shards per diamond. Double clicking Astral Diamonds in your inventory opens a Barter UI window to convert them into [[Astral Shard]]s. ** [[ Astral Shard]] inventory value is shared by all of your characters on that server, so [[Bind#Bound to Account (BTA)|BtA]] Astral Diamonds become account-shared Astral Shards, freeing up inventory or bank space. It doesn't matter on which character you convert them. | Category1 = Currencies | Category2 = DDO Store items }} [[File:Astral Shard UI.png|thumb|right|420px|{{Bug|Astral Diamond barter UI states Shards generated are BtC but it's a simple text error.|M=1}}]]
